facts.fact: The Ghana National Household Registry (GNHR) site describes the GNHR Registry as a single national database capturing household-level data across Ghana and the primary platform for identifying and targeting social protection beneficiaries.
The GNHR site says the registry targets beneficiaries of LEAP, school feeding and national health insurance (NHIS), and that its data is used by 15 programmes and 8 organisations over 2019-2026.

systems.owner: Ghana National Household Registry, Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection
